name: @hussmartinez/ui-example-native
description: An Expo application that uses the built @hussmartinez/ui/native, to prove that Metro resolves the package and Hermes compiles it (sdk-core ADR 0069).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 expo export --platform android --output-dir dist
